Usage

When to use. Attachment pills represent content grounded into a prompt — inserted from upload, OneDrive/Business, or the CiQ menu. The leading glyph communicates type (filetype color icon, Fluent line icon, or circular avatar for people/entities); the name truncates at 120px with an optional secondary line; the trailing chevron opens per-attachment options and doubles as the remove affordance.
